aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed SELECT RANK source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_116.json, which completes source registration for 11.1 at 268 of 268 base units across 11.1.1 through 11.1.12. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 259 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. authored_facets remains 1788, the fixture review states remain 1770 reference-validated, 274 source-reviewed and 1 needs-oracle, and the tests directory is untouched. Ten of the 21 scoped base units are newly accounted, because the eleven numbered items R1150 through R1153 and C1155 through C1161 were already counted; 63 facets remain pending. The author ran the pre-existing-fixture check over those eleven identifiers without being prompted by a failure and found none, which kept this packet out of the trap that blocked batch113, and the reviewer confirmed the check independently. The packet was blocked with one finding, closed and re-verified. C11SRR-001 observed that the first sentence of C1161 carries two distinct obligations rather than one: a named SELECT RANK construct's END SELECT statement shall specify a construct name, which is a presence requirement, and that name shall be the same, which is an equality requirement. The packet had a wrong-name negative and the mirror-image negative for an unnamed construct with a named END SELECT, but no facet at all for a named construct with an unnamed END SELECT, leaving a distinct prohibition with no oracle row. The correction added named-select-rank-unnamed-end-rejected, whose control differs in exactly one property, the presence of the name, taking the packet from 62 to 63 facets with requirements unchanged. Because a compound shall sentence whose second obligation goes unnoticed is a class of defect rather than a one-off, a compound-obligation sweep was required across the whole scope and then re-derived from the pinned document by the reviewer rather than accepted: C1155 has two obligations covered by three legitimate facets, C1156 and C1157 one each, C1158, C1159 and C1160 two each, C1161 three now covered, and R1150 through R1153 carry production alternatives with no omitted compound constraint. The rank-matching rules were derived independently from the source, both permissions were adjudicated including whether 11.1.10.1 p3 is a genuine permission or merely a statement of effect, and the ownership boundary against 11.1.3.3 was checked in both directions. SELECT RANK exists to handle assumed-rank dummy arguments, which live in unregistered Clause 15, and that dependency is flagged explicitly. Completing 11.1 source registration is not completing 11.1 testing: several hundred Clause 11 facets are pending and no Clause 11 fixture has been written. No SELECT RANK execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
